summary: Align Smalltalk Namespace delivery and background work with the shared sponsored-capacity priorities

replay.detail: CI scheduling labels only; no replay behavior changes for existing installations.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, client, protocol or harness changes; only Namespace runner admission priority changes.

downtime.detail: No service activation or interruption is introduced.

manual.detail: No installation action is required. Existing queued workflow revisions keep their runner labels; newly admitted runs use the new priorities.

recovery.detail: No state migration or runtime recovery change; reverting these workflow sources restores the previous queue priorities for future runs.
